repairs.quote: Orianna's Abilities originate from her Ball. Orianna's Ball automatically returns to her if she is too far away from it. Orianna's Attacks deal an additional ((10 ~ 50) + (15% Ability Power)) magic damage. Subsequent Attacks against the same target within 4 seconds deal an additional ((2 ~ 8) + (2.25% Ability Power)) magic damage (max of ((3 ~ 15) + (4.5% Ability Power)) damage).
